files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: Count the riders whose display name contains at least one letter outside the basic Latin alphabet A-Z (for example é, ø or ü). `result` should be that number (an integer).
intended_computation: Read riders.csv and count the rows whose display_name contains at least one alphabetic character that is not one of the 26 basic Latin letters (in either case), such as an accented letter. The answer is one integer.

acceptable_variants.notes: a numpy integer or an int-valued float is the same count

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
